headline: As of 2026-10-01: 703,827 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 27 of 50 states, D+38.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 703,827 early/mail ballots cast so far across 27 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+38.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (255,016), New Jersey (116,590), Pennsylvania (56,554).
